threads.body: Nothing in this package is referenced from outside it, so `public` is not needed here or on the three new `Fake*CollectorServiceHttp` classes and the new constructors. `serve` has to stay public as an override.
do we need to add a gzip decoder here?

replies.body: There wasn't one before. What makes this something to change in this PR?

Or are you suggesting that it's a good idea because clients might want that? I don't think it's required -- when I tested locally the defaults "just worked". If we default to gzip encoding on Android, maybe that becomes a configuration problem there? I dunno.
I thought gzip was default on Android, my bad.
No, I think you're right, it will be better and more straightforward if we just accept gzip out of the box. This is a good catch IMO. ❤️
That's what I get for multitasking.

threads.body: [Naming] An `ExportTraceServiceRequest` can hold spans from many traces, and the siblings here are `addMetricsRequest` and `addLogsRequest`. Rename this to `addTraceRequest` (callers in `FakeTraceCollectorServiceGrpc` and `FakeTraceCollectorServiceHttp`).
